app.name: Personal Eating Coach
app.tagline: Let's understand together how you eat

setup.title: Setup needed
setup.body: The app is not connected to Supabase yet. Add the environment variables to .env.local as described in the README and restart.

errors.invalid_credentials: The email or password is incorrect.
errors.missing_fields: Please enter your email and password.
errors.not_configured: The app is not connected to Supabase yet.
errors.unavailable: Signing in is not possible right now. Please try again in a moment.

sheet.title: What would you like to report?
sheet.note: The other options are still being prepared.

chooser.title: How would you like to tell me?
chooser.lead: You can take a photo or write it. I'll organize it.
chooser.photoHint: Take a picture of what you ate
chooser.textHint: Write it in your own words
chooser.photoOff: Photo analysis is not active yet. You can write instead.

resume.title: There is a report you didn't finish
resume.body: You can pick up where you stopped, or let it go.

photo.title: Take a photo of what you ate
photo.hint: If you can, keep people's faces out of the photo.
photo.cameraHelp: If the camera does not open, you can choose a photo from your library or write instead.
photo.notePlaceholder: For example: half the portion, no sauce
photo.unreadable: I couldn't open that photo. You can try another one or write instead.
photo.offline: There's no connection right now. The photo stays here, and you can send it when the connection is back.

photoUnavailable.title: Photo analysis is not active yet
photoUnavailable.body: For now you can write what you ate.

text.title: What did you eat?
text.placeholder: For example: two slices of bread with cheese and coffee
text.hint: Write the way you'd talk. Exact amounts aren't needed.
text.manualNote: Automatic analysis isn't available right now, so I'll keep what you wrote as a list. You can fix amounts and time afterwards.
text.empty: Write a few words about what you ate.
text.draftRestored: I brought back what you had started writing.
text.offline: There's no connection right now. What you wrote stays here, and you can send it when the connection is back.

processing.title: Trying to understand what you ate...
processing.slow: This is taking a bit longer than usual. You can keep waiting, or write instead.
processing.slowText: This is taking a bit longer than usual. You can keep waiting, or cancel.
processing.cancelled: Okay, I stopped. What you entered is still here.

ai_unavailable.title: Automatic understanding isn't available right now
ai_unavailable.body: You can keep what you wrote as a list and fix it afterwards.
ai_unavailable.bodyPhoto: You can write what you ate instead, and I'll organize it.

daily_cap.title: Automatic understanding has reached its limit for today
daily_cap.body: You can keep what you wrote as a list and fix it afterwards. It will work again tomorrow.
daily_cap.bodyPhoto: You can write what you ate instead. It will work again tomorrow.

rate_limited.title: I got a lot at once
rate_limited.body: You can try again in a minute, or keep what you wrote as a list.
rate_limited.bodyPhoto: You can try again in a minute, or write what you ate instead.

ai_error.title: I couldn't understand this one
ai_error.body: You can try again, or simply write what you ate.

nothing_found.title: I didn't find food here to understand
nothing_found.body: You can try a different photo or description.

not_signed_in.title: You need to sign in again
not_signed_in.body: After signing in you can come back to the report.

invalid_input.title: Something in the report didn't work out
invalid_input.body: You can check it and try again.

too_large.title: The photo is too large
too_large.body: You can try another photo or write instead.

unsupported_type.title: I can't use that file
unsupported_type.body: You can try another photo or write instead.

save_error.title: I couldn't save right now
save_error.body: What you entered is still here, and you can try again.

network.title: The connection dropped
network.body: The report may already have arrived. You can check, or try again.

action.saveAsWritten: Keep it as I wrote it

quiet.title: The app is quiet now
quiet.body: There is no need to report right now. When this time ends, we'll continue from there.

unavailable.title: I couldn't load this just now
unavailable.body: That's fine. You can go back to Home and try again in a moment.

confirm.title: This is what I understood
confirm.titleManual: Here is what you wrote, as a list
confirm.manualNote: I didn't analyze it, so you can add amounts and time in the fix if that matters to you.
confirm.fakeNote: Test result (fake), not a real analysis.
confirm.refreshed: This screen was updated to show the latest change.
confirm.notSaved: I couldn't save right now. You can try again.
confirm.unclearHint: You can add it in the fix.

edit.title: Edit the meal
edit.lead: You can change anything. After saving we'll go back to the confirmation.

errors.no_items: There needs to be at least one food.
errors.too_many_items: You can keep up to {max} items.
errors.amount_invalid: The amount needs to be a number above zero.
errors.unit_missing: Choose a unit for the amount.
errors.meal_type_invalid: Choose a meal type from the list.
errors.time_future: That time hasn't come yet. Choose an earlier time, or yesterday.
errors.time_too_old: You can fix meals up to two days back.
errors.not_saved: I couldn't save right now. What you entered is still here, and you can try again.

saved.title: Saved
saved.first: Got it. I've already started getting to know a little of how your food looks. There's nothing more you need to do now.

morning.title: Good morning
morning.body: You can start the day gently.

evening.title: Good evening
evening.body: There is no need to sum up the day. If there is something you want to share, I'm here.

beforeShabbat.title: Shabbat is coming
beforeShabbat.body: Candle lighting is at {time}. There is not much to do right now.

motzeiShabbat.title: Have a good week
motzeiShabbat.body: Shabbat has ended. You can continue at your own pace.

firstWeekStart.title: Our first week
firstWeekStart.lead: This week does not need to prove anything.
firstWeekStart.body: I just want to get to know you: how you eat, when it is hard, what helps, and what a regular day looks like.

silence.title: All is well
silence.body: There is nothing I think is worth adding right now.

offlineShabbat.title: Shabbat shalom
offlineShabbat.body: The app is quiet now. There is no need to report, no reminders and no tracking. See you after Shabbat.

offlineOther.title: The app is quiet now
offlineOther.body: There is no need to report. See you when this time ends.

firstReport.lead: When it suits you, tell me about one small thing. That is enough for a start.

home.degraded: Some information did not load just now, and that is fine. Tap "Home" to try again.

progress.title: Progress
progress.lead: What changes for you over time will appear here.
progress.body: There is not enough information to show anything yet, and that is fine. After a few reports we will start to see together what changes.

coach.title: Coach
coach.heading: Let's understand together
coach.body: Conversations with the coach are not open yet. When they are, you will be able to choose a topic or simply write what is on your mind.

me.title: Me
me.body: Settings and personal details will be added here later.

notFound.title: This page was not found
notFound.body: You can go back to Home and continue from there.

dev.title: System check (development only)
dev.rlsResult: Profiles I can see: {count} (should be 1, only mine)
dev.replayOnboardingHint: Development only. Your answers are kept and shown on each screen.

pause.before_second_portion: Just before a second helping, pause for a second. Then decide what feels right for you.

check_hunger.tired_or_hungry: Before you start, stop for 10 seconds and ask: am I hungry, or just tired?
check_hunger.open: Stop for 10 seconds and ask: am I hungry, or is something else going on? Hunger, tiredness, stress, or just a craving?

portion_first.default: Put one portion on your plate and start with it. When you finish, check whether you want more. Both answers are fine.

slow_down.utensils_between_bites: In one meal today, try putting your utensils down between bites.
slow_down.notice_before_next_bite: Midway through the meal, before the next bite, notice how it tastes and how you feel.

replace_context.default: This is usually a hard time of day for you. Try changing the context for a moment: move to another room or do something small and different. Then decide.

micro_walk.default: A 5-minute walk, even just around the house. When you get back, decide again.

eat_intentionally.default: At your next meal, sit down, put it on a plate, and take a few minutes without a screen.

environment.default: Today, try moving what tempts you into a drawer, and put what you want to eat somewhere visible.

delay.default: Want something? That's okay. Let's wait {delayMinutes} minutes and see if it's still there. If it is, you're welcome to enjoy it.

self_compassion_recovery.default: Today was a bit hard, and that's okay. What matters is that you're here. We continue from the next meal.

ask_instead.default: Just a small question: what's closest to what's happening right now? Hunger, tiredness, stress, or just a craving?

common.unavailableBody: The setup cannot load right now. You can try again in a moment.

errors.out_of_range: The value needs to be between {min} and {max}.
errors.too_long: The text is too long. You can shorten it a little.
errors.invalid_choice: Something about the choice did not work out. Please try again.
errors.conflicting_choices: This cannot be selected together with the other option.
errors.place_required: To work out the Shabbat times, please choose a place.
errors.unknown_place: That place is not in the list. Choose the nearest city.
errors.not_configured: The app is not connected to Supabase yet.
errors.unauthenticated: You need to sign in again.
errors.save_error: I couldn't save. What you wrote is still here, so you can try again.
errors.step_not_available: This step is not available yet. We'll take you back to where you stopped.
errors.profile_missing: No profile was found. Try refreshing, and if it keeps happening, sign out and sign in again.

welcome.title: Let's understand together how you eat
welcome.body: Just understanding what helps you eat and feel better.

goals.title: What would you like to improve?

options.understand_overeating: Understand why I eat too much

weight.title: What is your weight today?
weight.hint: This is only a starting point. There's no need to weigh yourself every day.

goalWeight.title: Is there a weight you would like to reach?
goalWeight.decline: I don't want to set a numeric goal

aboutYou.title: A few details so I can get to know you a little better

movement.title: What does your movement usually look like?

food.title: Is there anything I should know about your food?
food.style: Food style / things that are important for me to keep:

kashrut.title: Are there dietary restrictions or preferences I should know about?

offline.title: Are there times when you don't use your phone?
offline.placeHint: Not on the list? Choose the nearest city.
offline.minutesLabel: Minutes before sunset for candle lighting
offline.minutesHint: The default depends on the place. You can change it, and pressing Continue confirms the value.

why.title: Why is it important to you to make this change?
why.hint: You can write a few words. You can also skip.

notifications.title: How would you like me to be in touch?

device.title: Would you like me to send notifications to this device?
device.body: To send you what you chose, I need your permission for notifications on this device. You can also continue without them.

push.enabled: Notifications are on for this device.
push.denied: Notifications are blocked in the browser. You can change that in the device settings, and you can also continue without them.
push.unsupported: This browser does not support notifications. The suggestions will appear here in the app.
push.notConfigured: Notifications are not set up yet. You can continue, and your choices are saved.
push.errorTimeout: Notifications did not come together this time. You can try again, or continue without them.
push.errorSubscribe: I couldn't turn on notifications on this device. You can try again, or continue without them.
push.errorSave: Notifications were turned on, but I couldn't save that. You can try again, or continue without them.

ios.title: On iPhone, first add the app to the Home Screen
ios.step3: Tap “Add” and open the app from its icon.
ios.step4: Come back here and turn on notifications.
ios.hint: You can also continue without notifications for now.

ready.title: We're ready.
ready.line1: From now on you don't need to do much.
ready.line3: and I'll start learning what helps you.
